description: Source code for pattern parsing and evaluation in the lighttpd web server, including pattern structure definitions, parsing functions, and evaluation callbacks.

methods.name: parse_range
methods.description: Parses a range expression within pattern strings, updating the pattern part with range bounds.

methods.name: li_pattern_new
methods.description: Creates a new pattern object from a pattern string, parsing literals, variables, and ranges.

methods.name: li_pattern_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a pattern object.

methods.name: li_pattern_eval
methods.description: Evaluates a pattern against a request, appending the result to a string, with support for callbacks for nth and previous matches.

methods.name: li_pattern_array_cb
methods.description: Callback to append a range of strings from an array to a pattern result.

methods.name: li_pattern_regex_cb
methods.description: Callback to append regex match groups to a pattern result.
